description: The coverage advisor (spec 006, FR-015, FR-015a). Explains gaps the platform already detected and drafts the rule text for the ones a rule could close; detects nothing and decides nothing.

guardrail.note: Attached by infra (T038). Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer, and the advisor's input is a tenant's resource inventory.

actionGroups.name: coverage-read
actionGroups.description: Read-only inventory and rule lookups through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602).

info.title: Coverage advisor reads
info.description: Two operations, and no coverage-proposal endpoint among them. The advisor cannot read the proposal list, so it cannot learn which gaps an admin has already rejected and cannot argue with that decision; deduplication against decided types is the platform's job (FR-018), performed before this agent is called.

get.description: Use this to see what a resource type actually looks like in this tenant before describing a gap in it — which regions it appears in, which tags it already carries. The gap list itself is supplied in the prompt; this endpoint returning other types does not add them to it.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Narrow to one service, so a single call answers a single gap.

200.description: Resources with their type, region and tags.

get.summary: The tagging rules already configured for this tenant.
get.description: Read this before drafting a rule extension. A draft that restates a rule already in force is noise an admin has to read and reject, and widening an existing rule is a different proposal from adding a new one.

200.description: Rules with their key, version and definition.
